raw_response:
This rented plot is small, so I will grow groundnut using improved seed and some manure from my goats, plus a little NPK fertilizer left over from my FISP coupon. I will not spray pesticides or irrigate because the rains are enough and chemicals are too expensive for a food crop like this. My children and I will work here for about twenty days over the season, but I will not hire ganyu labor since the plot is too small to justify the expense.
